issue_context.title: Serialization: Stack<T> is deserialized in reversed order
comments: Thank you for reporting. I've opened #8768 with a fix + test.
I've opened https://github.com/dotnet/orleans/pull/8769 to ensure that this does not happen again.

review_comments: The crux of the fix is to populate an array in reverse order and then initialize the stack with it. Stack does not offer a way to get/modify the underlying array directly or enumerate in reverse order.
